mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, prefix, token_hash, scope, epoch, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, created_at, created_ip
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_token (id, user_id, name, prefix, token_hash, scope, epoch, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, created_at, created_ip) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{prefix}, #{tokenHash}, #{scope}, #{epoch}, #{expiresAt}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdIp})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM api_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE api_token SET last_used_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE api_token SET revoked_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE api_token SET revoked_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
